name: 1-solstice-bay.jpg
caption: v4.1 cover — Marigold Mile sunset pursuit: the sculpted red Solara GT (wheel-arch haunches, hood scoop, rear wing, bright hubs) driven by Remy at 70 MPH on the sun-lit slate boulevard with twin-yellow center lines and dashed white lanes, a blazing red/blue Interceptor on its tail, Bay Cab and traffic ahead, Marisol and Dex on the palm-lined sidewalk, AIR ONE banking in the sunset sky; three-star wanted HUD with SBPD tactical dispatch, mission stage card, weapon hotbar, crew cards, rank progress, car badge, Lena Vale dialogue with portrait and minimap route.

name: 2-air-one-chase.jpg
caption: Four-star AIR ONE intercept: the NOS-boosting red Solara GT with twin nitro flames at 84 MPH, three sculpted Interceptors with white doors, push-bars and red/blue strobe halos all fully in frame behind it, skid marks on the dashed-lane highway, AIR ONE's rotor-blur disc and searchlight cone locked on the roof; SBPD dispatch telemetry, AIR ONE DEPLOYED tag, four lit stars, weapon hotbar, car condition badge, radio chip and escape waypoint on the minimap.

name: 3-undertow-docks.jpg
caption: UNDERTOW docks rescue at sunset: Remy, Marisol and Dex approach the tall golden gate beam under gantry-crane silhouettes and container stacks, the western harbor channel shimmering before soft coastal ridges; Crane's crew holds the gate, with the mission stage card, SBPD patrol dispatch, weapon hotbar, crew tactical cards, Marisol dialogue portrait, Dex flank bark and SMG ready.

name: 4-strand-firefight.jpg
caption: BURN NOTICE firefight: Remy and Dex trade crossing tracers and muzzle flashes with three gang members behind a burning wreck and smoke column; teal sculpted getaway Solara with LED tail bar on the dashed-lane strand road, three-star AIR ONE DEPLOYED HUD, SBPD gunfire-response dispatch, weapon hotbar with HORNET SMG equipped, crew cards, Dex dialogue portrait and neon-lit pastel skyline.
